title: Gartner Identifies Top Supply Chain Technology Trends for 2026
summary: Gartner names agentic AI and physical AI as top supply chain technology trends for 2026, with AI moving from proof-of-concept to embedded, agentic capability inside core planning and execution processes.

title: MANE Selects Kinaxis to Strengthen Global Planning Capabilities
summary: MANE, a top-five global flavors and fragrances company, selected Kinaxis to modernize its planning capabilities as part of a broader enterprise-wide transformation initiative.

title: Kinaxis Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Supply Chain Planning Solutions
summary: Kinaxis was positioned as a Leader in both the Discrete Industries and Process Industries 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant reports for Supply Chain Planning Solutions.

title: Blue Yonder Named a Leader in the Inaugural 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Supply Chain Planning Solutions: Discrete Industries
summary: Blue Yonder was named a Leader in the first-ever Discrete Industries edition of Gartner's Magic Quadrant for Supply Chain Planning Solutions.

title: o9 Named a Leader in 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Supply Chain Planning Solutions (Discrete and Process Industries)
summary: o9 Solutions was recognized as a Leader in both the Discrete and Process Industries 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant reports for Supply Chain Planning Solutions.

title: Blue Yonder Releases Q4 2025 Company Highlights and Showcases New Solution Enhancements
summary: Blue Yonder reported 29 new customer logos added in Q4 2025 alongside enhancements to its Demand and Supply Planning and Warehouse Management solutions.

title: Logility Recognized in the 2025 Gartner Voice of the Customer for Supply Chain Planning Solutions
summary: Logility, an Aptean company, achieved a 4.9/5 overall rating and 100% Willingness to Recommend in the 2025 Gartner Voice of the Customer report for Supply Chain Planning Solutions.

title: Blue Yonder Releases Q3 2025 Company Highlights and Showcases Q4 2025 Industry Insights
summary: Blue Yonder added 24 new customer logos in Q3 2025, including 7-Eleven Philippines, Century Pacific, Catom, Dedeman, Mitchells & Butlers, and Societe Magasin General.

title: Kinaxis Powers Shimadzu's Supply Chain Advancement for the Modern Manufacturing Era
summary: Precision instrument maker Shimadzu selected Kinaxis Maestro to simulate trade scenarios and align cross-functional teams amid global tariff and trade volatility.

title: Disrupting the Norm: A Q&A with Mike Landry on ketteQ's $20M Series B and What's Next
summary: ketteQ CEO Mike Landry discusses the company's Series B raise, plans for global expansion, and continued investment in agentic AI and Agentforce-powered planning.

title: ketteQ Secures $20M Series B Funding to Scale Global Growth and Continued AI-Powered Supply Chain Planning Innovation
summary: ketteQ announced a $20 million Series B led by Vocap Partners, with the company citing Coca-Cola, Carrier, Johnson Controls, NCR Voyix, and Alliance Consumer Group among the companies it is trusted by.

title: Oracle Once Again Named a Leader in Gartner Magic Quadrant for Supply Chain Planning Solutions
summary: Oracle was again positioned as a Leader in Gartner's Magic Quadrant for Supply Chain Planning Solutions, underscoring continued competition among ERP-embedded and best-of-breed vendors.

title: Etex Selects Anaplan's Scenario Planning and Analysis Platform
summary: Global building materials manufacturer Etex selected Anaplan to run supply chain, finance, and commercial planning for its fiber cement business.

title: Logility Celebrates 2024 Achievements and Unveils 2025 Innovations
summary: Logility recapped 2024 wins and previewed 2025 product innovation, including expanded generative and agentic AI capabilities across its planning suite.
